facts.raw_span: A 70-year-old Japanese man presented with dysphagia
dysphagia
T3N0M0 esophageal squamous cell carcinoma
type 2 diabetes mellitus (HbA1c 6.6%)
percutaneous coronary intervention
radiotherapy for laryngeal cancer
cervical wound erythema with pus and saliva discharge
refractory anastomotic fistula
Enterobacter cloacae was cultured from the wound
worsening low back pain and fever (38.2 °C)
lumbar spinal tenderness and bilateral leg weakness without sensory loss
MRI of the lumbar spine demonstrated decreased T1 signal and increased T2 and STIR signal at L4–L5
